claim: Verify RED-S inside the first 90 days at the new section after PCS
quote: Ensure that an administrative audit of the Record of Emergency Data (RED) (DD Form 93) and Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance Election and Certificate (SGLV 8286)
fix: The audit happens on check-in, not within 90 days. Triggers are check-in, TDY over 30 days, before any deployment, before PCS departure approval, and triennially. Fix the PCS section and add the before-departure trigger.

claim: Section verifies annually
fix: Order requires the audit triennially. Annual counseling check is stricter and legitimate as local practice, but the summary presents it as the requirement. Say "at least every three years and at each trigger".

claim: A life event gives the Marine a 30-day window to submit the update

fix: Order says timely. No 30-day window exists in MCO 3040.4 or MCO 5000.14D.

claim: Source is MCO 5000.14D MCAP Enclosure 3
quote: INDIVIDUALS MARINES' ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES ... 5. Ensuring Record of Emergency Data (RED) ... are accurate
fix: The Marine's RED duty sits in Enclosure 2. Enclosure 3 is the commanders' list and does not mention the RED. Cite Encl 2 par 5 and MCO 3040.4 ch 1 par (8)(b).

claim: AC updates RED on Marine Online, Reserve on NSIPS

fix: MCO 3040.4 names MOL only. NSIPS for Reserve is not in the archive. Also the order wants a signed DD Form 93 for casualty cases.

claim: RED holds PNOK, SNOK, emergency contact, beneficiary data overlapping SGLI
quote: A form used to designate beneficiaries for certain benefits and designate the PADD in the event of the Service member's death.
fix: Order calls it Record of Emergency Data (RED), DD Form 93. "RED-S" is not a source term. Rename or define.

quote: this MARADMIN cancels reference (a) and further clarifies reporting requirements previously published in chapter 3 of reference (b).
fix: Supersession candidate is a false positive. MARADMIN 186/25 cancels MARADMIN 226/07 and clarifies chapter 3 of MCO 3040.4. It leaves MCO 3040.4 in force.
